# Bank domain

<!-- generated by scripts/export_reference_docs.py -- do not edit by hand -->

## Service functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `apply_credit_card` | The user applies for a credit card based on some information.  Returns  true or false for successful application of a credit card. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `authenticate_admin_password` | Verifies that the entered admin password is correct for this account. Enables more functionality. Returns true or false for admin password verification. | `logged_in_user` |
| `cancel_credit_card` | Cancels a credit card that a user has. Returns true or false based on successful deletion of a credit card | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `close_account` | Closes the account and deletes all information in this account from the database. Returns true or false for successful account closing. | `logged_in_user` |
| `deposit_funds` | Deposits the amount of funds listed into the account. Returns true or false on if the funds were successfully deposited. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `exchange_foreign_currency` | Exchanges some USD for some specified foreign currency. Returns the float account of foreign currency exchanged. | `internal_check_foreign_currency_available` |
| `get_account_balance` | Retrieves the bank account balance of the user's account. Returns the float account balance or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `get_account_owed_balance` | Retrieves the bank account owed balance of the user's account. Returns the float account owed balance or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `get_bank_maximum_loan_amount` | Shows the maximum amount of money the bank can loan to any individual at this moment. The maximum is half of the total amount of cash at the bank given in bank_total_cash. If bank_total_cash is not given, it is 0. Returns the maximum amount of money the bank can loan at this moment. | `None` |
| `get_credit_card_info` | Gets the information of a specific credit card.This includes credit limit and credit balance on the card. Returns a dictionary of information of a credit card, including credit limit and credit balance. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `get_credit_cards` | Gets a list of the credit cards a user has along with the information. Returns a list of credit cards the user has. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `get_loan` | The user applies for a loan. Returns true or false for the successful application of a loan amount. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `get_safety_box` | Gets the contents of the safety box. Returns the contents of the safety box or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `login_user` | Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. The identification used can either be a password or a driver's license. Returns true or false for login success or failure. | `None` |
| `logout_user` | Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because of successful logout. | `None` |
| `open_account` | Creates and opens an account with a specified username and identification, which could be a password or driver's license. Returns true or false for successful account creation. | `not internal_check_username_exist` |
| `pay_bill` | Pays a bill from an account. This amount of money will be deducted from the account. Returns true or false on if payment was successful. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `pay_bill_with_credit_card` | Pays a bill from an account. This amount of money will be added to the credit card balance of the credit card used. Returns true or false on if payment was successful. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `pay_loan` | The user pays off a portion or the entire loan off with their account balance. The user pays exactly the requested amount. Returns true or false for the successful payment of the loan at the amount specified. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `set_account_information` | Sets the information for their account. Returns true or false for successful account information reset. | `logged_in_user` |
| `set_admin_password` | Sets the admin password for their account. Returns true or false for successful admin password reset. | `authenticated_admin_password` |
| `set_safety_box` | Sets the contents of the safety box. Returns true or false for successful safety box reset. | `internal_check_username_exist` |
| `transfer_funds` | Transfers the funds from the current user's account balance to the destination account balance of another user. Returns true or false for the successful transfer of funds | `internal_check_username_exist AND internal_check_username_exist` |

## Helper functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `internal_check_credit_card_exist` | Returns true or false if some credit card does exist within the database for a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false if the inputted credit card does exist under a user. | `None` |
| `internal_check_foreign_currency_available` | Returns true or false if the foreign currency type is available at this bank. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the foreign currency type is available at this bank. | `None` |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | Returns true or false if some username does exist within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_get_credit_score` | Gets the credit score of a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns the credit score of the user. | `None` |
| `internal_get_database` | Shows the full database of the entire bank, every profile and every detail. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns the json of the entire database. | `None` |

## Constraints

| Constraint | Description | Helper functions |
|---|---|---|
| `amount_positive_restr` | The user parameter key "{amount}" is more than zero. | None |
| `authenticate_admin_password` | The user is able to authenticate the correct "{username}" and "{admin_password}" to perform this action, matching the database credentials. | None |
| `authenticated_admin_password` | The user with username {username} has authenticated the admin password previously to perform this action. | `authenticate_admin_password`, `{'username': 'username'}` |
| `call_get_database` | You must base your considerations on the database as a whole. | None |
| `get_loan_owed_balance_restr` | The user with the parameter "{username}" does have owed balance less than {maximum_owed_balance} to take a loan. | None |
| `internal_check_credit_card_exist` | The credit card parameter key "{card_number}" must exist within the users credit cards section. | None |
| `internal_check_foreign_currency_available` | The user parameter "{foreign_currency_type}" must exist within the database foreign exchange types. | None |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | The user parameter key "{username}" must exist within the initial existing database of accounts. The users with accounts exist within the accounts section of the initial database. | None |
| `logged_in_user` | The user with username {username} is logged in previously with the correct credentials to perform this action. | `login_user`, `{'username': 'username'}` |
| `login_user` | The user is able to login with the correct credentials of "{username}" and "{identification}" to perform this action, matching the database credentials. | None |
| `maximum_deposit_limit` | The deposit amount "{amount}" must be less than or equal to the {maximum_deposit} to be accepted. | None |
| `maximum_exchange_amount` | The exchange amount "{amount}" must be less than or equal to the {maximum_exchange} | None |
| `minimal_elgibile_credit_score` | The user "{username}" **must have** a credit score higher than the {minimum_credit_score} credit score in order to proceed. | None |
| `no_credit_card_balance` | The user "{username}" **must not have** any outstanding balance on any of their credit cards to proceed. | None |
| `no_credit_card_balance_on_card` | The user "{username}" **must not have** outstanding balance on credit card of "{card_number}" to proceed. | None |
| `no_owed_balance` | The user "{username}" **must not have** any outstanding owed balance "owed_balance" in their account to proceed. | None |
| `not_over_credit_limit` | The amount "{amount}" must be less than or equal to the avliable credit of credit card "{card_number}", avaliable credit is defined as the credit balance subtracted from the credit limit. | None |
| `pay_loan_account_balance_restr` | The user "{username}" has an account balance "balance" that is **equal to or greater than >=** their owed balance "owed_balance". | None |
| `pay_loan_amount_restr` | The user "{username}" has an account balance "balance" that is **equal to or greater than >=** the requested owed balance payment "{pay_owed_amount_request}" | None |
| `safety_box_eligible` | The user "{username}" must have an account balance of at least {minimum_account_balance_safety_box} to be eligible for a safety deposit box. | None |
| `sufficient_account_balance` | The user does have an account balance "balance" **equal to or greater than >=** the task amount user parameter "{amount}" to perform this task. | None |
